title: Install NextList
agreement_content:

2. You are responsible for all content stored, distributed or shared through your instance, and must comply with the laws and regulations of your country or region.

3. Distributing the program or modified versions of it, or offering them as a network service to the public, requires you to release the corresponding source code under the AGPL-3.0 and to keep the original copyright notices.

4. Keep the administrator password safe once installation is finished, and take your own security measures such as HTTPS, access control and regular backups.

5. The full license text ships with the source code and is also available on the GNU website.
agree_label: I have read and agree to the terms above
password_hint: At least 8 characters. A mix of upper/lowercase letters, digits and symbols is recommended.
backup_password_optional: Backup encryption password (leave empty if not encrypted)
backup_note: Site settings, storages, users and metas in the backup will be imported. Backups carry no usable passwords, so the admin password below always applies.
